solve.interpretation: A failed linear/contact iterate is not a movement or strength prediction. CONTACT_SCREEN records equilibrium and contact at its explicitly stated tolerances; it does not pass the original stricter solver gate. Even passing numerics use eroded reference slice geometry, unmeasured isotropic properties and idealized hardware. No full-bracket qualification.
